name: Piznik
summary: Deep in Windshear Mine, Piznik watches the Venture Company at work. Once second-in-command, he was pushed aside by Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle and now plots against his former boss.

sections.title: Fallen from Grace
sections.body: Before Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle took control of Windshear Crag, Piznik ranked second across the entire operation. When Gerenzo seized authority, the Venture Company pushed Piznik aside and sent him into the depths of Windshear Mine. Piznik has not accepted the demotion quietly. Underground, he watches the mine's movements and waits for a chance to take revenge on the boss who demoted him.

sections.title: Corporate Espionage
sections.body: Piznik's rebellion took shape through an alliance with Ziz Fizziks, another former Venture Company worker cast out by Gerenzo. From inside the mine, Piznik gathers what he can about Gerenzo's plans. He smuggled a sample of the mysterious gold-green ore Gerenzo ordered mined in bulk to Ziz. Together, they work to disrupt the Venture Company's deforestation and mining efforts, bringing setbacks to Gerenzo's leadership.

faq.answer: Piznik is deep inside Windshear Mine, in the tunnels carved into Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Venture Company workers are nearby.

faq.q: What is Piznik's grudge against Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle?
faq.answer: Piznik once ranked second across the Windshear Crag operation. When Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle took command of the logging and mining project, he demoted Piznik, who now resents him and wants to see him ruined.

faq.q: How does Piznik fit into Ziz Fizziks' plans?
faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks was fired by Gerenzo, while Piznik was demoted. Piznik uses his access inside Windshear Mine to learn of Gerenzo's plans and get a sample of the mysterious ore to Ziz.

faq.q: Is Piznik still loyal to the Venture Company?
faq.answer: Piznik remains a Venture Company employee so he can stay inside the mine. He acts for his own interests and wants to sabotage Gerenzo.

angles.text: As a miner, you may cross paths with Piznik inside Windshear Mine, where he watches the company that demoted him.
